Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gourmet Gatherings Catering provides exceptional catering and food preparation services for a variety of events, including corporate functions, weddings, and private parties. Our operations focus on delivering high-quality, made-to-order meals, along with a selection of appetizers and desserts, tailored to our clients' specific needs. We prioritize using locally-sourced ingredients and work exclusively with licensed and insured vendors for any necessary rentals or entertainment services. Our team is experienced in managing events in venues of various sizes, but we steer clear of larger venues to mitigate liability risks associated with guest capacities and alcohol sales. We also ensure compliance with food safety regulations to maintain the highest standards of hygiene and prevent any potential health risks.

Industry-Specific Restrictions
To maintain underwriting discipline and control loss exposure,
the following industry-specific restrictions apply:
• Venue Size and Alcohol Thresholds: As noted, venues exceeding 7,500 sq ft or 150
seats, or those with alcohol sales over 50% of beverage revenue, are generally excluded due to
increased liability risks.
• Auto and Cyber Coverage Limitations: Auto coverage is only extended if the insured
operates vehicles directly related to the business (e.g., shuttle services for guests). Cyber
coverage eligibility depends on the service model—venues handling online bookings or storing
sensitive client data require enhanced cyber protections.
• Restriction on Use of Unlicensed Vendors: The insured must use only licensed and
insured third-party vendors for catering, entertainment, and equipment rentals. Use of unli-
censed vendors is prohibited due to increased liability and coverage gaps.
